name: ms-windows-server-2022-stig

descriptions.data: Using a privileged account to perform routine functions makes the computer vulnerable to malicious software inadvertently introduced during a session that has been granted full privileges.
descriptions.label: default

descriptions.data: Verify each user with administrative privileges has been assigned a unique administrative account separate from their standard user account.
descriptions.label: check

descriptions.data: Ensure each user with administrative privileges has a separate account for user duties and one for privileged duties.
descriptions.label: fix

requirements.title: Windows Server 2022 users with Administrative privileges must have separate accounts for administrative duties and normal operational tasks.

descriptions.data: The longer a password is in use, the greater the opportunity for someone to gain unauthorized knowledge of the password.
descriptions.label: default

descriptions.data: If there are no enabled local Administrator accounts, this is Not Applicable. Review the password last set date for the enabled local Administrator account.
descriptions.label: check

descriptions.data: Change the enabled local Administrator account password at least every 60 days.
descriptions.label: fix

requirements.title: Windows Server 2022 passwords for the built-in Administrator account must be changed at least every 60 days.

descriptions.data: Using applications that access the internet or have potential internet sources using administrative privileges exposes a system to compromise.
descriptions.label: default

descriptions.data: Determine whether organization policy prohibits administrative accounts from using applications that access the internet.
descriptions.label: check

descriptions.data: Establish a policy, at minimum, to prohibit administrative accounts from using applications that access the internet.
descriptions.label: fix

requirements.title: Windows Server 2022 administrative accounts must not be used with applications that access the internet.

summary: This Security Technical Implementation Guide is published as a tool to improve the security of Department of Defense (DOD) information systems.
title: Microsoft Windows Server 2022 Security Technical Implementation Guide
